Room 055,

PF.66074/F.3.m.

Officer i/c Records,
Pioneer Corps,
Bournemouth.

We understand that No.13095115 Private William OLDAG, Pioneer Corps, was declared a deserter on 27.3.43.

May we please be informed of this soldier's present unit if he has been apprehended, or notified in the event of his being apprehended in the future.

Lieut-Colonel J. Baskervyle-Glegg.

M.I.5.
1.4.44.

RGM/PB
